name: A Vernal Mishap
source:
A Vernal Mishap is a short visual novel (Around 14.000 words) where you play as a faerie that keeps falling for the human she's trying to scam.  Will she go through with her plan, or give it all up for the one that she loves?

[From [url=https://yosharoos.itch.io/vernal-mishap]itch.io[/url]
translation:
A Vernal Mishap是一部短篇视觉小说（大约14,000字），你在其中扮演一个不断爱上她试图欺骗的人类的仙女。她会坚持自己的计划，还是为了她所爱的人放弃一切？

[来自[url=https://yosharoos.itch.io/vernal-mishap]itch.io[/url]
